title: Apocalypse Clock: Global Systemic Risk Monitor
description: Apocalypse Clock is an experimental, browser-based systemic-risk dashboard for exploring interacting global threats through scenario controls, Monte Carlo uncertainty sampling, dependency-aware aggregation, Weibull horizon diagnostics, network analysis, and exportable model outputs. The project is not peer reviewed. Model outputs are scenario outputs, not predictions.
notes: Version 1.5.0 keeps dataset v1.9.0 unchanged and extends the 23-threat functional-cascade model with sampled structural uncertainty (cascade threshold, criticality tiers, dependency weights and lags, growth classes) and with sampled pressure turns followed by recovery by reversibility class. Under Baseline, Expert weights, seed AC-1.2.6-2026 and 3,000 runs, Dynamic Cascade P10/P50/P90 is 2034/2038/2046. The dashboard adds a section menu, page search, a canvas causal dependency network built from a research register of threat links, and a tabbed Model Diagnostics section. The model does not claim empirical calibration or predictive validation. Released under the custom source-available non-commercial fork license; the project is not peer reviewed and outputs remain conditional scenarios, not predictions.
